## Review checklist

- [ ] No credentials, private ad data, state files or provider transcripts are included.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests cover failure/refusal as well as success.
- [ ] Mutation changes preserve stage/apply policy, exact approval, read-back and unknown outcomes (or not applicable).
- [ ] Documentation, tool/skill metadata and capabilities match implemented behavior.
- [ ] AI-assisted output has been reviewed; no unrun checks are described as passed.

## Risks

Describe remaining uncertainty, compatibility or private-state impact. Do not replay an unknown write.
